sources.title: P2 — compute the full mean time to first disconnection
sources.role: Accepted supplied premise: independent-network static-to-dynamic calculation, conditional failed-state sampler, return-avoidance estimator; not revalidated.

sources.title: Efficient Estimation of Rare-Event Kinetics
sources.role: Strong prior: equilibrium plus downhill trajectories for rare-event kinetics; reverse inference itself is not new.

sources.title: Temperature-accelerated dynamics for simulation of infrequent events
sources.authors: Mads R. Sorensen; Arthur F. Voter
sources.role: Strong prior: discovers unknown mechanisms under harmonic transition-state assumptions.

sources.title: Mathematical Analysis of Temperature Accelerated Dynamics
sources.role: Rigorous idealized QSD analysis of TAD.

sources.title: Comparison Theorems for Reversible Markov Chains
sources.role: Classical Dirichlet-form comparison machinery; not a claimed new comparison principle.

sources.title: A Randomized Fully Polynomial Time Approximation Scheme for the All-Terminal Network Reliability Problem
sources.role: Invoked static all-terminal unreliability FPRAS; not implemented in the demonstration.

sources.title: Joint Fluctuation Theorems for Sequential Heat Exchange
sources.authors: Jader Santos; Andre Timpanaro; Gabriel Landi
sources.role: Collision-model context; present proof separately requires explicit reciprocal amplitudes.

sources.title: Violation of Detailed Balance in Quantum Open Systems
sources.authors: Robert Alicki; Milan Sindelka; David Gelbwaser-Klimovsky
sources.role: Boundary: Gibbs stationarity alone need not give detailed balance.

sources.title: Forest matrices around the Laplacian matrix
sources.role: Positive tree/forest representation used for the finite-factory-error mean bound.

sources.title: Astra N1607 — Port-acquired risk in a hidden thermal family
sources.role: Relevant accumulated prior construction in reciprocal linear Gaussian systems. Read by collaborator; not imported as a premise for the present jump architecture.

sources.title: Multiensemble Markov models of molecular thermodynamics and kinetics
sources.authors: H. Wu; F. Paul; C. Wehmeyer; F. Noe
sources.role: TRAM prior: combines thermodynamic and kinetic information from multiple ensembles; a strong alternative for interacting molecular landscapes.

sources.title: Hyperdynamics: Accelerated Molecular Dynamics of Infrequent Events
sources.role: Accelerated-dynamics prior: boosts rare transitions while reconstructing kinetic time under the method's bias conditions; no blanket superiority is claimed.

sources.title: Elementary Thermal Operations
sources.authors: M. Lostaglio; A. M. Alhambra; C. Perry
sources.role: Thermal-operation context and boundary: energy preservation plus a thermal ancillary state is not a substitute for the explicitly imposed probability reciprocity.

sources.title: Micro-reversibility and thermalization with collisional baths
sources.authors: Jannik Ehrich; Massimiliano Esposito; Felipe Barra; Juan M. R. Parrondo
sources.role: Physical collision and micro-reversibility context; supports retaining the complete collision assumptions rather than inferring detailed balance from an incomplete bath model.

sources.title: A Combinatorial Proof of the All Minors Matrix Tree Theorem
sources.publication: SIAM Journal on Algebraic and Discrete Methods 3, 319–329 (1982)
sources.role: Classical all-minors tree/forest theorem supplies the positive numerator representation used in the finite-state ratewise mean sensitivity proof.

sources.title: Spectral Rate Theory for Two-State Kinetics
sources.authors: J.-H. Prinz; J. D. Chodera; F. Noe
sources.role: Established reactive-flux and spectral kinetics machinery; those concepts are not claimed as new.

sources.title: The surprising efficiency of temporal difference learning for rare event prediction
sources.publication: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 37 (2024)
sources.role: Strong short-trajectory alternative: favorable relative asymptotic variance for rare-event prediction in finite-state models; distinguished from the present finite-confidence local physical acquisition and succinct network computation.

novelty_status: Targeted primary-source comparison only; no priority certification.
evidence_status: Original proofs and synthetic computational demonstrations; no hardware execution.
